dct_description_sm: Data compiled by the University of Toronto Data Library Service. Cleanup by: Rashed Ahmad, Eric Campbell, Benjamin Smeets, Nathan Wolfe.  LF86B03 – Basic summary tabulation from the 1986 Canada Census. It includes data on population 15 years and over by labour force activity (7 variables), highest level of schooling (8 variables) and sex (3 variables).
